game.controlsLine: Move: Left / Right · Rotate: Up, X, Z / Ctrl · Soft: Down · Hard: Space · Hold: C · Pause: Esc · Resume: P · Paused: Up/Down + Enter · Menu (when paused): Esc · Mode help (paused): Esc closes
game.pauseCopy: Resume: P · Quit: Esc · Move: Up / Down · Select: Enter or Space · Sound: M · Mode help: Esc closes

marathon.label: MARATHON
marathon.tooltip: Endless play; level up every 10 lines.
marathon.description: Classic endless Tetris. Speed increases as you level up every 10 lines cleared. Play until you top out, lock out, or block out.
marathon.howToWin: No win condition - survive as long as possible and chase a high score.

sprint.label: SPRINT
sprint.tooltip: Clear {goal} lines as fast as you can.
sprint.description: A race against the clock. Clear exactly {goal} lines as quickly as possible. Level stays at 1 for consistent speed.

ultra.label: ULTRA
ultra.tooltip: Score as much as you can in {minutes} minutes.
ultra.description: Two minutes on the clock. Score as many points as you can before time runs out. Lines still level you up during the match.
ultra.howToWin: Get the highest score possible when the {minutes}:00 timer hits zero.

multiplayer.label: MULTIPLAYER
multiplayer.tooltip: Local multiplayer coming soon; plays as Marathon for now.
multiplayer.description: Multiplayer mode is not fully implemented yet. For now this plays like Marathon with a single board.
multiplayer.howToWin: Same as Marathon until true local multiplayer arrives.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overviewBody: Transcendence is an educational project built for the 42 ft_transcendence curriculum. It is a fan-made Tetris-style game maintained by a small group of students. We do not run analytics, advertising, or tracking of any kind. This page describes the very limited data the application handles so you know exactly what happens in your browser when you play.
privacy.notCollect1: No accounts, names, email addresses, or other personal identifiers.
privacy.notCollect2: No analytics, telemetry, or usage tracking.
privacy.notCollect3: No advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.localStorageBody: Your gameplay preferences (such as the selected variation and player count) are kept in a Pinia store inside the running tab. Where the project persists those preferences, it does so using your browser's own storage (for example localStorage). This data never leaves your device, is never sent to a server, and can be cleared at any time from your browser's site-data controls.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: The Credits page loads developer avatars directly from GitHub (github.com/<handle>.png). When you visit that page, your browser makes a request to GitHub to fetch the image. Those requests are handled by GitHub under their own privacy policy. No other third-party services are contacted by the application.
privacy.childrenBody: Because we do not collect any personal data, the application does not knowingly gather information from anyone, including children. There is no account system and no age gate.
privacy.controlsBody: You can clear any locally stored preferences at any time by clearing site data for this domain from your browser's settings. Doing so will reset gameplay preferences to their defaults the next time you load the page.
privacy.changesBody: As the project evolves, this policy may change. Updates will be committed to the project repository, and the Last updated date above will reflect the most recent revision.
privacy.contactBody: Questions or concerns can be raised by opening an issue on the project repository:
